acakostic11: Nobody asked Teodor Acakostic why he came. Nobody in R-F13 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Teodor Acakostic answered the first call, number 10 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Teodor Acakostic measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

At Calvary Farm, Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony and Yann Vee of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Teodor Acakostic watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Teodor Acakostic helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Teodor Acakostic fired at a movement across the wire at R-F13. The man went down: Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth, gravely wounded.

A shell burst in the trench at R-F13. Teodor Acakostic was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run. The beds were full. Teodor Acakostic waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Teodor Acakostic helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Teodor Acakostic spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Teodor Acakostic never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Teodor Acakostic raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F13. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Marek Ham of the Concord (@rals.ham).

A bullet went into Teodor Acakostic's chest just under the heart at R-F13. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth of the Concord (@spencerbonthoux). The bearers reached Teodor Acakostic at R-F13 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Florian "Mud" Spencerbonth of the Concord (@spencerbonthoux).

Walter "Crow" Acakostic arrived carrying the family name of Teodor Acakostic. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Walter "Crow" Acakostic is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.

Walter "Crow" Acakostic was on watch at R-F13 when the night raid hit. The men found Walter "Crow" Acakostic at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Alessiosanto of the Concord (@alessiosantori).

The House of Acakostic sent another. Roland "Mud" Acakostic, father of Walter "Crow" Acakostic, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. One of the first hundred, Roland "Mud" Acakostic was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the paper that came with it in oilcloth to keep it safe.

Roland "Mud" Acakostic was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F13. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Dorian Spencerbonth of the Concord (@spencerbonthoux). The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F13 changed before the cheering ended. Roland "Mud" Acakostic shouldered another load.
Roland "Mud" Acakostic no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Roland "Mud" Acakostic offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
A supply man offered Roland "Mud" Acakostic a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Roland "Mud" Acakostic in the open at R-F13. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Florian Oaustin of the Concord (@oaustin77). Roland "Mud" Acakostic looked over the parapet at R-F13 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Florian Oaustin of the Concord (@oaustin77).
Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic took the same post at R-F13 where Roland "Mud" Acakostic stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Pavel "Ash" Nugg was badly wounded. Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Valentin Crobus was badly wounded.
airman.w.uke: Yann "Lucky" Uke came from Tannenfeld, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Yann "Lucky" Uke found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Yann "Lucky" Uke lost a boot in the trench. Ivo "Smokes" Fox found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Yann "Lucky" Uke (Concord) and Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Lantern Hill at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Yann "Lucky" Uke began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
covonarson: In Oakmere, Matthias Covonarson was a coal miner. In S-R10, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a coal miner again.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Matthias Covonarson read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet went through Matthias Covonarson's sleeve at S-R10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Otto Carlingiti of the Hegemony (@carlingiti). Matthias Covonarson got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 815. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Matthias Covonarson looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Matthias Covonarson was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R10. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous of the Hegemony (@krokous21).
Matthias Covonarson spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
Matthias Covonarson returned to S-R10 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Matthias Covonarson aimed a step ahead and fired: Walter Jesus, badly wounded.
Matthias Covonarson cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Hill 304. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.
dick_j0b: The quartermaster asked Arno Dick to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Arno Dick tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Dick. Arno Dick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A shell landed square in S-F19. They found Arno Dick alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Arno Dick was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Arno Dick opened his eyes today and asked for water. At S-F19 they cheered when the news came up the line. Hill 304 has been won. Arno Dick listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Arno Dick slept most of the day. When he woke, someone had left a cup of tea on the crate beside the bed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Dick. Arno Dick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Arno Dick never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Dick. Arno Dick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Arno Dick drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Arno Dick gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Dick. Arno Dick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F19. Arno Dick was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp of the Concord (@vitocarcioppolo).
Albin "Shadow" Dick joined S-F19 under the shadow of Arno Dick's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Albin "Shadow" Dick had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Florian Normale was grazed. Albin "Shadow" Dick got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 247. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Albin "Shadow" Dick could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Albin "Shadow" Dick fired, and Benedikt Ahmadifard was grazed.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Albin "Shadow" Dick's ear at S-F19 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Emil "Mole" Odin of the Concord (@odin21320).
Albin "Shadow" Dick walked back up the communication trench to S-F19, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Pavel Jessemusoff stood up to sing louder, and Albin "Shadow" Dick fired. Pavel Jessemusoff was gravely wounded. The singing stopped. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin "Shadow" Dick. Albin "Shadow" Dick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F19 they left Albin "Shadow" Dick behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Lucien Gloose of the Concord (@klekarh_gloose).
A letter came with Clement Dick: "I am Albin "Shadow" Dick's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
drowning.in._: The new rifleman gave his name as Severin Drowning. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Severin Drowning helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Across from T-F12, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Severin Drowning saw it. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex was grazed. The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Severin Drowning fired, and Severin Poopdoop was grazed. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Severin Drowning did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The men have learned that Severin Drowning is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Severin Drowning's hands still remember being a carpenter's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
A round went through the rim of Severin Drowning's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Clement Front of the Concord (@always_out_front).

Severin Drowning took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at T-F12, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Clement Front of the Concord (@always_out_front).
Severin Drowning spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
femboy_green: The new sniper gave his name as Wendel Green. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The first hundred were recognised, and Wendel Green was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
Wendel Green held a letter up to the daylight to read the faint last lines. They were only a shopping list, written on reused paper.

Wendel Green noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down the change. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Wendel Green stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
At the Sunken Road, Wendel Green of the Hegemony and Oskar Eddie of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Dawn watch. Wendel Green put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Gideon Actioncam, grazed.

Wendel Green noticed regular flashes from a gap beneath a roof beam. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Wendel Green folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A loose thread in Wendel Green's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
A bullet clipped Wendel Green's helmet at R-F15 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Jonas "Owl" Askey of the Concord (@roman_askey_).
Wendel Green came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Wendel Green watched a gap beneath a roof beam through another shift. The flash returns at the same angle, even when nothing else moves.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F15. Wendel Green was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Bram "Crow" Matroska of the Concord (@maksim_matroska_42).

The papers say Gideon Green. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Wendel Green's eyes. Nobody in R-F15 argues. Gideon Green's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Gideon Green's ear at R-F15 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear of the Concord (@colemarkpearson). News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Gideon Green during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet struck Gideon Green below the ribs at R-F15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Jonas "Owl" Askey of the Concord (@roman_askey_). Gideon Green was killed at R-F15 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Jonas "Owl" Askey of the Concord (@roman_askey_).
The House of Green sent another. Silas Green, uncle of Gideon Green, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A round went through the rim of Silas Green's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Gideon Actioncam of the Concord (@actioncam3000).
The wound Silas Green shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
For days Silas Green was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

Silas Green had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Florian Warrior, badly wounded. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Silas Green aimed just below it. Casimir Man was badly wounded.
gat_king: They issued Nils King a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his brother's pocket watch in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Nils King helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Nils King and Otto Chuckemuckle argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Nils King pulled Benedikt "Saint" Wilson out of a flooded shell hole at Verdel Ridge. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Nils King in the open at P-F18. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Lucien Curi of the Concord (@iago_curi). Nils King was killed on watch at P-F18. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Lucien Curi of the Concord (@iago_curi).
Ivo King arrived carrying the family name of Nils King. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Ivo King. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Ivo King caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
hi.its.guy: Severin Guy left a younger sister who sends drawings behind in Belmonte and came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there. The men noticed at once that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments.
Severin Guy of the Concord and Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

A bullet clipped Severin Guy's helmet at S-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib of the Hegemony (@wiwiwib3). News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F20 with the rations. Severin Guy ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet found Severin Guy at S-F20, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Walter Juizy of the Hegemony (@juizy_44).
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Severin Guy was carried in at last.
An orderly read the newspaper aloud in the ward. Severin Guy fell asleep halfway through the war news, which was the point.
For days Severin Guy was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

At S-F20 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Severin Guy turned around and took a shovel blow. Rafael Broadshoulde of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Rafael Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-F20, Severin Guy listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Three days with a bandage, and Severin Guy is back at S-F20. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Severin Guy is number 320. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is lost. Severin Guy heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Severin Guy aimed just below it. Roland "Hollow" Bomb was gravely wounded.
Severin Guy spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow.
Leopold Ker and Severin Guy have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.

Severin Guy was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F20. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins). Severin Guy stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F20. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins).
The papers say Nils Guy. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Severin Guy's eyes. Nobody in S-F20 argues.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Nils Guy dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Otto "Crow" Miller coming out. It was over in seconds. (@ryder_miller11) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Nils Guy hit Emil Ghostbebrii with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@ghostbebrii)
icecreampapito: Day 10. The corporal put Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi tried to remember the price of a loaf in Port Abel. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi went out with the wiring party at T-F5. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi on the wire, halfway home.
Clement Icecreampapi took the same post at T-F5 where Nils "Hollow" Icecreampapi stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
jackmears.priv: Severin Priv introduced himself as a butcher's boy from Saint-Lune. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Severin Priv tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at N-F3 is up. A letter from home reached Severin Priv before dusk. Severin Priv read it twice and slept a little easier.
A parcel came for Severin Priv that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Severin Priv came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A bullet went through Severin Priv's upper arm at N-F3 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Isidor Lee of the Hegemony (@michael_lee6767).
jacobhoekstra22: On Day 11 Tobias Jacobhoekstr took a post at V-F9 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He reads the same book over and over, and the men liked him for it. Grey Mill is lost. Tobias Jacobhoekstr heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Tobias Jacobhoekstr turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias Jacobhoekstr. Tobias Jacobhoekstr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Tobias Jacobhoekstr was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

The parcel for Tobias Jacobhoekstr contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias Jacobhoekstr. Tobias Jacobhoekstr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit Tobias Jacobhoekstr in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at V-F9. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Dietrich Notceyshhauc of the Hegemony (@notceyshhauceyban). Tobias Jacobhoekstr looked over the parapet at V-F9 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Dietrich Notceyshhauc of the Hegemony (@notceyshhauceyban).
Anselm "Button" Jacobhoekstr joined V-F9 under the shadow of Tobias Jacobhoekstr's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Anselm "Button" Jacobhoekstr was on the dawn watch at V-F9 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Anselm "Button" Jacobhoekstr was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Clement Necrowizard of the Hegemony (@return_of_the_necrowizard).
logan.crawford283: By the time Jonas "Whistle" Crawford reached T-F7, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Jonas "Whistle" Crawford fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Yann Argall was badly wounded. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jonas "Whistle" Crawford helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Jonas "Whistle" Crawford pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Jonas "Whistle" Crawford saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F7 and fired once. Tobias "Hollow" Evie was grazed.
Jonas "Whistle" Crawford found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
A bullet found Jonas "Whistle" Crawford at T-F7, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Tobias Charlesdiabl of the Concord (@charlesdiablo).

The wound Jonas "Whistle" Crawford shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Jonas "Whistle" Crawford was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
lzed003: "You're late," said the corporal when Benedikt Lzed arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Benedikt Lzed watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lzed before dusk. Benedikt Lzed read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Lzed found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lzed before dusk. Benedikt Lzed read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt Lzed is number 764. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Benedikt Lzed read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Benedikt Lzed sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lzed before dusk. Benedikt Lzed read it twice and slept a little easier.

The cook borrowed Benedikt Lzed's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lzed before dusk. Benedikt Lzed read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Benedikt Lzed was hit through the chest at R-C5. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Benedikt Lzed waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Benedikt Lzed no longer needed it.
The papers say Marek Lzed. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Benedikt Lzed's eyes. Nobody in R-C5 argues.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Marek Lzed offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. A letter from home reached Marek Lzed before dusk. Marek Lzed read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek Lzed began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A letter from home found Marek Lzed before the night shift. Marek Lzed folded it small and kept it close.
michaelamice: Karel Michaelamice arrived with the Day 15 draft, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

The Concord raiders came over at V-F22 in the middle of the night. Karel Michaelamice met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Edmund Epgmaker of the Concord (@epgmaker).
A letter came with Gustav Michaelamice: "I am Karel Michaelamice's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
prithvirajs.chauhan: After 9 days of war, R-C4 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan was faster. Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr was grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A muddy dog crawled into R-C4 through the wire. Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Mercy. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan is number 800. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan swept the enemy parapet at R-C4 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Jonas Steini was grazed.
Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan (Hegemony) threw a loaf of bread into the Concord trench at Lantern Hill. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Albin "Tin" Krut: 'Fair trade.'
Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan fired back. Henrik Kream was badly wounded.
A round went through Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Benedikt Aidanthompso of the Concord (@aidanthompson0319).
Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
reza_zdsh: Nobody saw Silas Zdsh arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F10, and a quiet field cook under it.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Silas Zdsh was number 21. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Silas Zdsh tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Yann Vee (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) met in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm during a raid. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Edmund Matteozrybak wrote a letter for Silas Zdsh's mother, because Silas could not find the words. Silas signed it.
Edmund Acquillae taught Silas Zdsh to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.

Marek Red (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Calvary Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. From Verdel Ridge the Concord guns have a clear view. Silas Zdsh wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The salvo walked along S-F10 and caught Silas Zdsh in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Silas Zdsh was carried in at last.
Another quiet day in the ward for Silas Zdsh. He counted the cracks in the ceiling and got to forty-one.

Silas Zdsh spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Silas Zdsh helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Silas Zdsh never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) and Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at the Drowned Farm. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Silas Zdsh counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Silas Zdsh accepted it as a review.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Silas Zdsh was hit hard in the fight at S-F10 before anyone could fire. The raider was Marek Jackmdunn of the Concord. Raider: Marek Jackmdunn of the Concord (@jackmdunn06). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Silas Zdsh watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F10. Silas Zdsh took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Silas Zdsh fell at S-F10 and never moved again. Shot by Roland Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0).

Konrad Zdsh arrived carrying the family name of Silas Zdsh. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Konrad Zdsh's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Konrad Zdsh did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Konrad Zdsh was hit through the chest at S-F10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam of the Concord (@ritualforsam_26). Konrad Zdsh looked over the parapet at S-F10 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam of the Concord (@ritualforsam_26).
Pavel Zdsh asked about Konrad Zdsh on arriving at S-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Pavel Zdsh's ear at S-F10 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Matthias "Shadow" Deakins of the Concord (@charlie.deakins).
The medic looked at Pavel Zdsh's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F10. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Pavel Zdsh put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Pavel Zdsh was carrying water up to S-F10 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Pavel Zdsh did not. Shot by Anselm Dominicktheb of the Concord (@dominickthebombinick25).
simohayha2405: Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha came up with a draft of replacements on Day 8. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Severin Martinsatali of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at Verdel Ridge. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha (Hegemony) and Dietrich Danxdoody (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near Calvary Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. The clerk counted the names twice. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha is number 577 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
The parcel for Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.

Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha was carrying water up to S-S16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha did not. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha fell at S-S16 and never moved again. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring).
Jonas Simohayha arrived carrying the family name of Henrik "Smokes" Simohayha. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Jonas Simohayha held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
Jonas Simohayha tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
Jonas Simohayha found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
white__phosphor: Day 10: Jonas Phosphor reached P-F1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Jonas Phosphor read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Phosphor kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Jonas Phosphor rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Nils Amourika was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.

Jonas Phosphor was hit twice at P-F1, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Konrad "Button" Jasierralta of the Hegemony (@jasierralta). Jonas Phosphor looked over the parapet at P-F1 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Konrad "Button" Jasierralta of the Hegemony (@jasierralta).
Gideon Phosphor came to the front because his cousin Jonas Phosphor never came home. He carries a photograph gone soft at the edges.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Gideon Phosphor had just lit a cigarette at P-F1 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic.
Gideon Phosphor no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dawn watch. Gideon Phosphor put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Konrad "Button" Jasierralta, badly wounded.
